exam.title: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official guide highly recommends related training and one year of hands-on production data-engineering experience across Python/SQL/Spark, batch and streaming pipelines, CDC, orchestration, testing, sharing/federation, observability, cost/performance, privacy/governance, CI/CD and dimensional modeling.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Developing Code for Data Processing using Python and SQL

review.notes: The July 3, 2026 detailed live-version PDF and current ten-domain weighted page were reconciled. Every objective maps to production code/configuration, data/state, identity, quality, observability, cost/performance, privacy, deployment, failure and recovery evidence. Three scenarios, eight labs and 37 original checks cover modular Python/bundles/dependencies/UDFs/tests; batch/stream acquisition; Lakeflow/Structured Streaming/AUTO CDC/control flow; transformations/quarantine; D2D/open sharing and federation; system tables/profiles/Spark/event/API evidence and alerts; managed-table maintenance/deletion vectors/skipping/clustering/CDF; layered access/privacy/purge; metadata/inheritance; repair/CI/CD; and Delta/dimensional modeling. All 30 guide URLs are cataloged: 28 reachable and O'Reilly/Udemy searches automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Commercial entries are discovery routes rather than claimed complete current courses, and retired vendor sample questions are linked rather than reproduced.

findings.title: Specific serverless retry objective was underexplained
findings.evidence: The exam names auto-optimization to disallow retries; current docs identify a separate serverless control.
findings.recommendation: Explain environment/memory scope and automatic retry controls with a labeled bundle fragment.
findings.resolution: Explain environment/memory scope and automatic retry controls with a labeled bundle fragment.

findings.title: Streaming recovery needed destination and checkpoint boundaries
findings.evidence: Delta idempotency is destination-specific and new checkpoints reset batch numbering.
findings.recommendation: Add partial-commit replay and new-identity explanation with bounded local model.
findings.resolution: Add partial-commit replay and new-identity explanation with bounded local model.

findings.title: CDC ordering contract was underspecified
findings.evidence: Distinct updates need unique non-null ordering per key.
findings.recommendation: Add conflicting-sequence and historical cutover cases.
findings.resolution: Add conflicting-sequence and historical cutover cases.

findings.title: Purge explanation lacked physical file sequence
findings.evidence: REORG rewrites affected files, while old files require later cleanup.
findings.recommendation: Separate logical visibility, rewrite, retained old files and downstream evidence.
findings.resolution: Separate logical visibility, rewrite, retained old files and downstream evidence.

findings.title: Sales example omitted import and silently lost unmatched facts
findings.evidence: Inner join drops missing dimension keys; duplicate matches multiply aggregates.
findings.recommendation: Add import, left join, unknown category and explicit dimension/quality contracts.
findings.resolution: Add import, left join, unknown category and explicit dimension/quality contracts.
